scope: Second review of every one of the 1000 sourceModule specifications for direct breadboard insertion. Existing component IDs, pin IDs, canonical anchors, default artwork and native geometry remain unchanged. Explicit per-instance physical views recover compatible modules whose published source illustration includes rear contacts.

evidencePolicy.contacts: Each supported SKU explicitly lists its reviewed complete downward male-header contacts on the owning specification. Manufacturer connector package/board CAD or dimensioned physical header evidence establishes centers; reference footprint copper or a module tag never opts a part in.
evidencePolicy.sourceArchives: All 531 Adafruit, SparkFun and Seeed EAGLE board files were matched locally to the existing per-SKU SHA-256 before connector package review. DFRobot and mikroBUS reviews retain each SKU’s cited manufacturer CAD/dimension/physical pinmap evidence.
evidencePolicy.scale: The sourceModule coordinate transform supplies the actual canonical source origin and units per millimeter. The whole mounted illustration uses that calibrated scale; default library and native geometry retain their existing source coordinates.
evidencePolicy.precision: Exactly 145 MIKROE source maps document at most 0.001 mm coordinate rounding of nominal 2.54 mm headers. Their insertion coordinates use the manufacturer nominal grid; default canvas anchors and native source coordinates remain unchanged. No other source profile receives that tolerance.
evidencePolicy.fullCoverage: Every selected whole primary connector is populated completely and every declared downward lead must fit. Optional whole duplicate headers may face upward or remain unpopulated only where each omitted terminal is already electrically connected to a selected insertion lead in the existing canonical internalConnections model. Unique essential electrical functions are not dropped to force a fit.
evidencePolicy.castellations: For reviewed CASTEL packages, only the inner round plated holes receive downward male headers. Separate outer castellated contacts retain their original IDs and wiring endpoints. Every omitted edge alias is already electrically connected to its inserted inner hole in the canonical model.
evidencePolicy.view: Profiles with rear contacts expose an explicit complete mounting.view map. A new fitted instance stores part.view = "breadboard"; raw instances and earlier scale-only projects retain their original mirrored-view anchors. The physical component-side view projects every contact to source x/y: plated through-holes can be shown from this side; genuinely hidden rear-only pads receive dashed BACK PAD markers. Detachment retains the explicit physical view.
evidencePolicy.body: Physical material regions follow source-unit PCB and both-side projecting hardware primitives. Rear hardware is projected in place without the separate illustration display offset. Margins, captions, shadows and silkscreen do not reserve breadboard holes. Projecting rear hardware has a matching dashed BACK HARDWARE outline in the compact illustration. This does not certify stylized bodies as production mechanical geometry.
evidencePolicy.nativeAccuracy: Existing per-SKU KiCad footprint/CAD accuracy assessments are unchanged. Breadboard insertion metadata does not upgrade a reference carrier to a manufacturer production footprint or upgrade approximate generated 3D geometry.

validation.fullPlacementAudit: Every enabled complete source header map must pass actual fitting, attachment validation and saved-project round trips on an electrically safe terminal-bank pose. Rear view activation is explicit and old anchors remain unchanged.

source.label: MIKROE MIKROE-4177: v101 physical insertion headers

headerGeometryEvidence.geometry: Manufacturer mikroBUS primary 16-pin header: 2.54 mm pitch and 22.86 mm row spacing. Physical header centers come from the cited per-SKU manufacturer CAD, including the reviewed nominal-grid precision where declared.

entries.installation: Install straight 2.54 mm male headers with insertion leads below the component-side PCB. Every explicitly listed header lead must enter a separate compatible breadboard hole. Leave all unlisted optional headers unpopulated or facing upward; do not insert sockets, screw terminals, solder jumpers, or short solder stubs. Mounting explicitly activates the component-side physical view: through-hole contacts are shown at their real top-projected centers, while hidden rear-only pads use a distinct BACK PAD projection.
entries.bodyEvidence: Source-unit PCB envelope plus individual projecting physical package rectangles/circles from the existing source-coordinate component-side and rear hardware illustrations. Rear packages are projected at their physical centers, without applying the separate-view display offset. Captions, silkscreen text, margins and shadows are excluded. Regions retain separate overhangs rather than their empty enclosing wings.

physicalView.activation: part.view = "breadboard", set only by a reviewed insertion; retained on detach.
physicalView.evidence: Manufacturer source coordinates projected onto the component side. Through-hole centers remain visible from this side; dashed BACK PAD markers identify hidden rear-only contacts. The physical view activates only through explicit breadboard placement.

source.label: SparkFun LCD-13003: EAGLE SparkFun_Micro-OLED_Breakout.brd; commit c7dd8939c905 physical insertion headers

headerGeometryEvidence.geometry: Exact manufacturer EAGLE connector package and full plated header rows reviewed. Only source-identified primary header holes are insertion leads. Source model internal connections verify every excluded duplicate header/castellation terminal is electrically represented by a selected lead.

entries.installation: Install straight 2.54 mm male headers with insertion leads below the component-side PCB. Every explicitly listed header lead must enter a separate compatible breadboard hole. Leave all unlisted optional headers unpopulated or facing upward; do not insert sockets, screw terminals, solder jumpers, or short solder stubs. Mounting explicitly activates the component-side physical view: through-hole contacts are shown at their real top-projected centers, while hidden rear-only pads use a distinct BACK PAD projection.
entries.bodyEvidence: Source-unit PCB envelope plus individual projecting physical package rectangles/circles from the existing source-coordinate component-side and rear hardware illustrations. Rear packages are projected at their physical centers, without applying the separate-view display offset. Captions, silkscreen text, margins and shadows are excluded. Regions retain separate overhangs rather than their empty enclosing wings.

physicalView.activation: part.view = "breadboard", set only by a reviewed insertion; retained on detach.
